# RZ Announce [LEGACY]

**RZ Announce** is a legacy plugin for automatically sending colorful messages to Minecraft server chat. It supports modern message design with MiniMessage, including gradients, rainbows, HEX colors, and clickable links. Ideal for greetings, news, and important announcements.  

> This project is no longer supported. All new updates and improvements are now in **Yoo Announce**.  

## Features

* Automatic sending of messages at specified intervals  
* Multi-line messages with MiniMessage effects  
* Clickable links and custom color schemes  
* Messages sent to players and console simultaneously  
* Easy customization via `config.yml`  
* Commands for reloading the plugin and viewing info  
* Console logo at startup  

## Commands

```
/cordannounce reload - reload plugin configuration 
/cordannounce info - plugin info
```

## Permissions

* ``cordannounce.reload`` - reload configuration
* ``cordannounce.info`` - view plugin information
